Signalsmith Stretch 1.3.2 (npm "signalsmith-stretch", MIT license, see LICENSE.txt)
https://signalsmith-audio.co.uk/code/stretch/  -  JS/WASM release by Geraint Luff / Signalsmith Audio Ltd.

SignalsmithStretch.js: the UMD build from the npm tarball, unmodified
  (sha1 of the tarball 8549203d56c12c1ddf6f4083e4781bab19eae839; the WASM binary is embedded as base64).
Used by DNB-808 Live (section 3z+ COMPLEX PRO, integ/c33_prowarp.js): loaded inside the warp render worker only,
for offline time-stretch and pitch shift. Nothing runs on the audio thread.
The npm package ships no license file: LICENSE.txt is the MIT text of the upstream repository
(github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch, LICENSE.txt).
